stories.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh for the first time as Trump cuts short his Camp David trip
stories.reason: The strike triggered flight disruptions at King Khalid International Airport and a US State Department security alert across the Middle East, with Trump's abrupt return to the White House fueling speculation of a major response to come.

stories.title: Russia holds a parliamentary election for the first time in Ukrainian regions it illegally annexed
stories.reason: Ukrainian rights activists say local election officials went house to house escorted by Russian troops to coerce voting in Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia and Crimea, as Kyiv urges the world not to recognize the results.

stories.title: Anthropic targets a $2 trillion November IPO as its alignment science lead admits no plan exists to safely build superintelligence
stories.reason: Evan Hubinger wrote that people inside frontier AI labs 'really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans' and put his own extinction-risk estimate above 10% within the decade, an unusually blunt admission from a company racing toward what could be the largest tech IPO ever.

stories.title: Online sports gambling is linked to a 25-30% rise in personal bankruptcies in states that legalized it
stories.reason: Research finds roughly 30,000 additional bankruptcies and an 8% rise in debt collections annually tied to legalized mobile wagering, with under-40 bettors seeing delinquency rates near 26% on at least one account.

stories.title: 30-year mortgage rate hits a 19-month high of 6.95%, up from 6.26% a year ago
stories.reason: The jump in borrowing costs for even well-qualified buyers compounds an already sluggish housing market, coming the same week as the Fed's rate hike and adding pressure on affordability heading into the fall buying season.

stories.title: Consumer sentiment sinks to record lows despite a solid economy; Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'
stories.reason: Michigan's sentiment index fell 13% year-over-year even as GDP growth continues, with Goldman's economists tying the disconnect to declining trust in institutions rather than the economy's actual performance.

stories.title: India sends 11 tonnes of relief material to flood-affected Nepal
stories.reason: The shipment of medicines, tents and sleeping bags comes as the two countries' finance officials also meet to discuss post-flood reconstruction, trade and energy cooperation following the catastrophic glacial flooding that killed over 1,400 people.

stories.title: Fed's dot plot signals one more rate hike before year-end, with four officials favoring an even bigger increase
stories.reason: The median 2026 rate projection rose to 4.1% from 3.8% in June, with only two of eighteen officials seeing no further hikes -- meaning businesses and consumers already squeezed by mortgage and borrowing costs should brace for tightening to continue.
